conviction_note: The bar is tight and sourced: a 17-broker consensus that Cellnex published itself, for a contracted towers business that printed Q2 revenue within 0.4% of its consensus. So I expect the numbers to land in line, with 2026/27 guidance reiterated. The stock rose 19% in the 20 days before the print and sold off on its last two capital-return announcements (-3.6% on 9M25, -0.4% on H1 26). That puts p_up slightly below 50 (46). abs_move is sized at 3.2, above the name's own small history, because the period is new and a 2027 remuneration plan may come with it. The findings sum to -0.4 and the scaled number is -0.26; both are small and both negative, so there is no real disagreement between them.

already_public.what: Company-compiled Q3 2026 consensus (median of 17 brokers): revenue EUR1,015m, adj. EBITDA EUR860m, EBITDAaL EUR655m, RLFCF EUR473m, FCF EUR162m
2026 shareholder remuneration of EUR1bn: EUR500m dividend (paid Jan and Jul), EUR300m H1 buyback, and an additional EUR200m buyback running Aug to 31 Dec 2026, reported 62% done by 14 Oct
Fitch affirmed BBB- with a stable outlook on 27 Oct 2026
Broker previews: Jefferies RLFCF EUR475m against a EUR488m consensus (as cited via Bolsamania), with 'limited room for a material sales surprise'; BofA has FCF slightly below consensus

new_in_release.expect: In line with the company consensus. Q2 revenue was EUR1,010m against a EUR1,006m consensus, and the contracted revenue base leaves little room for a surprise. Not expected to move.

2026 and 2027 targets reiterated (base case). A small risk of language placing 2026 adj. EBITDA at the low end: on the company consensus, 9M is about EUR2,547m, so Q4 needs at least EUR878m (+2.1% q/q) to reach the EUR3,425m low end.
FCF of about EUR162m against consensus. 9M of about EUR463m leaves the 600-700 guide comfortable. BofA flags a slight shortfall. Direction unknown, slight negative lean.
A 2027 shareholder-remuneration plan is possible, by analogy with 9M25, when the EUR1bn 2025-26 plan was announced. Its size and timing are not sourced. The last two such announcements were sold.
Possibly a date for the medium-term-objectives update that Jefferies expects next year. Direction unknown.

bar: Cellnex's own published consensus for Q3 2026 (median of 17 brokers, 22 Oct 2026): revenue 1,015 / adj. EBITDA 860 / EBITDAaL 655 / RLFCF 473 / FCF 162 EUR m, https://www.cellnex.com/app/uploads/2026/10/Cellnex-Resultados-3T-2026-Pronostico-Consenso.pdf. The RLFCF bar is partly disputed: Jefferies cites a EUR488m consensus against the company's EUR473m (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/cellnex-stock-heads-into-results-with-jefferies-forecast/70444275).
session_check: bmo (relative to the 2026-11-06 event date). The issuer's own financial agenda lists '05 November 2026 Results Q3 2026 (*)', with (*) marking it 'Pending confirmation' (https://www.cellnex.com/sections/shareholders-investors-financial-agenda-table/). Aggregator previews dated 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 put the release later on 5 Nov, before a 6:30 pm CET analyst call (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/cellnex-stock-heads-into-q3-results-with-cash-flow-in-focus/70462438). A Spanish preview says 'después del cierre del mercado' (es.benzinga.com, snippet only, Cloudflare 403). The precedents fit: Bolsamania timestamped the H1 26 story 18:41 CEST on 30 Jul 2026, and the 9M25 call was the day after the release. So the release falls after the 5 Nov close and before the 6 Nov open. The sealed window, close 2026-11-05 to close 2026-11-06, is correct. An 'amc' reading of the 6 Nov event date (6 Nov close to 9 Nov close) would be wrong. I have no issuer timestamp.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market: the CNMV grid returns no rows from this container, so the aggregate short interest is unknown, not zero. One press-reported disclosure: Merca2 (2 Oct 2026), citing CNMV records, says D.E. Shaw raised its net short to 1.00%, its highest in the name, up from 0.90% in mid-August, while the stock stood at EUR22.17. It is now about EUR26.9 (+21%). Whether the position has since been cut is unknown. priced_lean_pct (-0.96) is the 20-day run-up, which is also the free control.

findings.finding: The largest disclosed short, D.E. Shaw, was building into early October (0.90% in mid-August to a record 1.00%, per CNMV records reported 2 Oct 2026). The stock has since rallied 21%, from EUR22.17 to about EUR26.9, so the short is under water and a clean, reiterated print could force more covering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to a short disclosure on this name. The October rally came with rate and oil relief and the buyback (XTB, 9 Oct: +4% on lower oil and rate fears).
findings.original_quote: El hedge fund D. E. Shaw & Co ha elevado su apuesta contra Cellnex hasta el 1,00% de sus títulos. Se trata del porcentaje más alto de su serie histórica en la compañía, por encima del 0,90% comunicado a mediados de agosto. [D.E. Shaw has raised its bet against Cellnex to 1.00% of its shares, the highest in its history in the company, above the 0.90% reported in mid-August.]
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline has no short data, because the CNMV register is unreadable here, and only the Spanish press reported the position. If the market had fully absorbed a cover, the 5-day run-up of +4.8% would sit beside a published reduction below 1%. None was found. A 1% single-holder short is not crowded, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Merca2 frames the short as a rates bet rather than a bet on the business ('Los cortos no apuestan contra las torres de Cellnex: apuestan contra el calendario de los tipos'), which is the same article. Nothing else points the same way.

findings.finding: The last two times Cellnex announced shareholder returns with results, the stock fell: the EUR1bn 2025-26 remuneration plan with 9M25 (6 Nov 2025), then -3.6% on 7 Nov 2025 ('cae más de un 4% pese a anunciar que retribuirá al accionista con 1.000 millones'); the extra EUR200m buyback with H1 26, then -0.4% on 31 Jul 2026. A 2027 package plausibly comes with this 9M release, after a +19% 20-day run-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M25 with the EUR1bn plan: -3.59% close to close on 2025-11-07, intraday more than -4%. H1 26 with the EUR200m buyback: -0.37% on 2026-07-31, after a +1.78% gap. Yahoo daily bars: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/CLNX.MC?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.original_quote: Cellnex cae más de un 4% pese a anunciar que retribuirá al accionistas con 1.000 millones hasta 2026 [Cellnex falls more than 4% despite announcing it will return EUR1,000m to shareholders through 2026]
findings.why_not_priced: It is a reaction pattern, not a hidden number. What is not priced is whether a 2027 plan comes with this release and how large it is. Nothing sourced says either way, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: The H1 26 reaction (-0.37% on 31 Jul 2026 after the EUR200m buyback, https://www.cellnex.com/app/uploads/2026/07/2026.07.30-PR-Cellnex-H12026-Results.pdf for the announcement) is a second occurrence from a different release.

findings.finding: On the company's own consensus, FY26 adjusted EBITDA reaches the EUR3,425m low end of guidance only if Q4 delivers at least EUR878m (Q1 832, Q2 855, Q3 consensus 860; +2.1% q/q needed). That leaves room for 'low end' wording in the reiteration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cellnex has reiterated guidance at every print in 2026 (Q4 25, Q1 26, H1 26), and those days moved between -0.4% and +3.3%. No observed guide cut under the current management.
findings.original_quote: El EBITDA ajustado ha aumentado hasta los 832 millones de euros (+6,4% orgánico pro forma) ... Cellnex reitera sus previsiones financieras para 2026 y 2027 [Adjusted EBITDA rose to EUR832m (+6.4% pro-forma organic) ... Cellnex reiterates its 2026 and 2027 financial forecasts]
findings.why_not_priced: This is my own arithmetic from three documents, not a broker claim. The FY consensus was not found, so the market may already sit at the low end, and Q4 has historically been seasonally strong (FY25 segment revenue sums to about EUR3,995m against 9M25 of EUR2,937m). It is an inference and sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 adj. EBITDA of EUR855m comes from Bankinter's results blog (https://www.bankinter.com/blog/empresas/resultados-cellnex). The H1 guide table is in https://www.cellnex.com/app/uploads/2026/07/2026.07.30-PR-Cellnex-H12026-Results.pdf. Nothing independent points to a low-end statement.

findings.finding: Sell-side previews lean slightly below the bar on cash: BofA (19 Oct) expects FCF to improve in H2 but come in slightly below consensus, and Jefferies has RLFCF at EUR475m against the EUR488m consensus it cites.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M25 revenue came in about 2% under that quarter's published consensus of 995 (implied Q3 25 about 974 from Jefferies' +4.2% y/y), and the stock fell 3.6% the next day, though the remuneration plan came out at the same time.
findings.why_not_priced: These are broker previews, so they are mostly priced. The company's own consensus (473) already sits at Jefferies' number, so the dispute is over which bar. That caps the finding small.
findings.independence: Jefferies (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/cellnex-stock-heads-into-results-with-jefferies-forecast/70444275) is a different broker making the same point.

findings.finding: Cheap financing and a stable credit view going into the print: an EIB loan of EUR375m for 5G infrastructure (announced 3 Nov 2026) and Fitch's BBB-/stable affirmation (27 Oct 2026). The money funds BTS rollout inside the existing capex guide, so it is not a distress signal.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: S&P's move to Positive outlook came with H1 25 (Aug 1 2025, +1.26%). No isolated reaction is measured.
findings.why_not_priced: Both are public and mostly priced. The small positive is that the call will be able to cite cheaper funding against the refinancing-cost concern Jefferies names.
findings.independence: The EIB loan was reported separately (https://www.estrategiasdeinversion.com/cotizaciones/indices/mercado-continuo/cellnex, snippet only).

outside_window.finding: Medium-term-objectives update, which Jefferies expects next year, is a later catalyst
Completion of the EUR200m buyback, due by 31 Dec 2026 (62% done by 14 Oct)

baseline_tension: The small negative tilt (sell-the-news on capital returns, slightly soft cash previews) agrees with the run-up lean (-0.96). The one positive item, the building D.E. Shaw short now under water, is the only part orthogonal to the run-up, and it is small.
language_note: Spanish press (Merca2, 2 Oct 2026) carried the CNMV short disclosure, D.E. Shaw at a record 1.00%. The baseline has no positioning data and no English source surfaced it.

'Open session_check with the verdict and cite the timestamp': the session check now opens with 'bmo' relative to the 6 Nov event date. The evidence is an after-close release on 5 Nov, which stays inside the sealed window.
